title: Ratchet the docs/architecture.md word ceiling down to the policy headroom
task:
Problem: scripts/doc-budgets.manifest.json:4 sets `docs/architecture.md` at 2400 words while `pnpm run verify-doc-budgets --list` reads 1288 words, 46% slack. scripts/verify-doc-budgets.ts:4-5 states the rule the manifest follows: "Ceilings ratchet down with at least 5% headroom; raising one requires the justification defined in docs/AGENTS.md", and docs/AGENTS.md:57 sets the target for architecture.md at 1,800 words or fewer, with "At or below target, retain at least 5% headroom" and "Lower a ceiling only when the document still has room". architecture.md is below its target with room, so its ceiling is the one manifest entry the ratchet applies to: of the other eight, AGENTS.md (1900/1900), docs/AGENTS.md (1320/1320), packages/README.md (1067/1067) and packages/AGENTS.md (672/675) are above their targets and therefore frozen, and docs/cordis-primer.md, docs/defensive-patterns.md, docs/testing.md and examples/AGENTS.md sit within 4-24% of their ceilings.

Required: lower `docs/architecture.md` to a ceiling with at least 5% headroom over the current count (1288 x 1.05 = 1353; choose a round value between 1360 and 1400) and change nothing else; `pnpm run verify-doc-budgets` must pass. State the `--list` numbers in the commit message.

Constraints: no prose change to any budgeted document; do not touch other ceilings; a one-line manifest edit, no Agent Note. The budget gate is the gate for this change; the queue's mandatory coverage run names dsh-skill-filesystem, a package this change cannot affect, and passes before and after.
